text: 何以熨平颠簸的经济周期？诺奖双雄解析：从家庭消费到央行决策 如果说霍尔攻克了居民消费端的微观预期，伍德福德则把这块拼图装进了涵盖企业与中央银行的完整政策框架中。
text_en: How to Smooth Out Bumpy Economic Cycles? Nobel Duo Explains: From Household Consumption to Central Bank Decisions — If Hall conquered the micro-level expectations on the consumer side, Woodford fitted this piece into a complete policy framework covering firms and central banks.
